label: README.md#MCP tools
title: README.md#MCP tools
summary: 47 tools, served identically over both transports (stdio and the daemon's /mcp endpoint). The live registry is the TOOLS array in lib/mcp-core.js. (Tasks themselves are created with Claude Code's native TaskCreate; these tools manage them once they exist.)
